title: CompLit: Scientific Literature Search Benchmarks Must Cover Implicit, Cumulative, and Unmet Needs
abstract: arXiv:2610.28658v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: How much can we trust an agent to find the paper we need? As researchers, we search the literature from what we have read toward what we have not. We thus describe what we want in our own terms, which a paper may show only implicitly; our requirements grow as we read; and what we seek may lie in an empty region no paper yet covers. We introduce CompLit, a literature search benchmark spanning all eight arXiv domains, with one diagnostic setting for each of these needs. The strongest agents, Codex (GPT-5.6-Sol) and Claude Code (Opus 4.8), answer 86-87% of Standard queries, yet fall to 66-68% when requirements are implicit (implicit), lose another 6 and 15pp, respectively, as they accumulate (cumulative), and abstain on at most 53% of the queries no paper satisfies (unmet). translated_title: CompLit：科学文献搜索基准必须涵盖隐性、累积性与未被满足的需求
translated_abstract: 我们对智能体找到所需论文的信任程度能有多高？作为研究者，我们搜索文献是从已读走向未读的过程。因此，我们用自己的语言描述需求，而论文可能只是隐含地体现这些需求；我们的需求会随着阅读不断累积；我们所寻找的内容也可能位于尚无论文覆盖的空白区域。我们提出了CompLit，一个覆盖全部八个arXiv领域的文献搜索基准，针对上述每一种需求分别设置了一个诊断性测试场景。最强的智能体Codex（GPT-5.6-Sol）和Claude Code（Opus 4.8）能答对86-87%的标准查询，但当需求是隐性时降至66-68%；随着需求累积，二者又分别再下降6和15个百分点；而在没有任何论文能满足的查询上，它们最多只有53%能正确弃答。没有任何智能体在所有领域都领先，且所有智能体对2019年之前或2023年之后的论文准确率都较低。通过追踪智能体的搜索过程，我们发现它们常常能够到达正确的论文（原文在此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出了覆盖全部八个arXiv领域的文献搜索基准CompLit，通过隐性需求、累积需求和未被满足需求三个诊断场景，揭示出当前最强智能体在真实科研文献搜索中性能会显著下降。
en_tdlr: Introduces CompLit, a literature search benchmark spanning all eight arXiv domains with diagnostic settings for implicit, cumulative, and unmet needs, revealing that even the strongest agents show significant performance drops in realistic scientific literature search.
